C3. Restored tensile response is not a useful pressure/force certificate

For an introduced undeformed isotropic thick-cylinder screen,20N piston force at100kPa requires inner radius7.979mm. If one HYPOTHETICALLY assigns healed tensile strength.34MPa and proof factor1.5, Lame inner hoop stress p*(b^2+a^2)/(b^2-a^2) requires outer radius12.813mm and wall4.834mm. At introduced density1200kg/m3 and100mm length, body material is37.895g before end seals, reinforcement, motion mechanism or repair hardware.

This borrows no tested pressure-body property from the Beckett tensile specimens. Large-strain hyperelasticity, fatigue, actual crack mechanics, humidity and chemical compatibility remain open. Added reinforcement can alter the load path, but its own damage, joining and restoration then belong to the useful operation. A sealed hole, recovered no-load shape or compensated tip force is not by itself restored force through useful stroke.
